entry.title: Litchfield Planning board: Housing development (2026-10-20)
entry.summary: ...March 1989. The Board discussed allowing mixed-use development by removing the limit of one residential unit alongside a commercial use. The district is within the Multifamily Overlay District, where [multifamily housing] is permitted. The change would not independently allow single-family residential development where otherwise prohibited; existing single-family homes would remain grandfathered. Members also consider...
